Package an5.adapters.base

Class JdbcUrls

java.lang.Object
an5.adapters.base.JdbcUrls
public final class JdbcUrls extends Object
Connection strings to JDBC URLs.

A JDBC URL is mandatory and positional, while the connection strings the rest of AN5 takes are ADO-style or URI-style. Every environment spellings are accepted here so a project can keep one DATABASE_URL across all its clients.
